textdraw_58910fdcf6d245dda735b201db8b329._value: The customer acknowledges explicitly the following provisions applying accordingly:

textdraw_ef34c3b2029b49fb9f35852414b5d9f._value:
1. The orders transferred by the Contracted Bank are processed on the business days published in the "Schedule of prices and services" on the handling of the order type "credit transfer" in the course of normal operations. If the order arrives according to the time specified in the "Schedule of prices and services” (term of acceptance), or if the time of the arrival fails to fall on a business day according to "Schedule of prices and services" the order is considered received on the following business day. The order will only begin to be processed on that day.
  2. UBS is entitled to execute orders for the customer provided by the Contracted Bank via SWIFT.
  3. The revocation of an order transferred by the Contracted Bank and received by UBS is excluded.
  4. The communication between the Contracted Bank and UBS is performed unsecured via the public not specifically protected data communications network. UBS is not liable for losses resulting from transmission errors, technical defects, cyberattacks or malfunctions, unless the changes were performed by UBS systems. In this case, UBS' liability is limited to losses caused directly intentionally or as a result of gross negligence by UBS. The liability on account of culpable injury to life, body or health remains unaffected.
  5. If required for providing the EFT services, the customer releases UBS from the banking secrecy and agrees explicitly to the data transfer to the Contracted Bank. The customer is aware that the German law only applies within Germany and data transmitted abroad are no longer subject to this protection.
  6. The fees depend on the Schedule of prices and services. The customer authorises UBS to withdraw the fees for the UBS Multibanking Services from its account via IBAN
  7. This agreement can be terminated mutually in writing at any time subject to a term of 7 days. The right to an extraordinary termination remains unaffected.
  8. This agreement shall be subject exclusively to the Laws of Germany. The place of performance and place of jurisdiction shall be Frankfurt am Main. UBS is authorised to assert its rights also at the location of the customer or before any other competent authority or court. The agreements concluded upon opening the banking relationship shall apply accordingly.
